in_hebrew.name: Armyn
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Armyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'armenos', meaning a soldier or a warrior. In the New Testament, the name Armyn is not directly mentioned, but the name Arnold, which shares the same meaning and origin, is used for several characters.
